description: X.509 certificates for the COSE cross-validation suite, minted by Bouncy Castle and read back by both implementations. Generated by tools/CertificateCorpus — deterministic, so regenerating it should change nothing. Every key here is printed in this file and secures nothing. `privateKeys` holds the keys that sign messages, each with the COSE algorithm it signs with; `issuerKeys` holds authorities' keys, which sign certificates and have no COSE algorithm, and are here so that tools/X509Cases can mint certificates under those authorities.
